components.title: compliant-s3
components.description: Reusable Terraform pattern for an AWS S3 primary bucket plus a dedicated access-log bucket. Hardcodes server-side encryption, versioning, public access block, access logging, and required compliance tags.
components.purpose: Provide a compliant-by-default S3 primitive that any team can adopt with three lines of consumer Terraform.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by this module.

implemented-requirements.description: AES-256 server-side encryption is enforced via aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration. Hardcoded; consumers cannot override.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.

implemented-requirements.description: Access enforcement is guaranteed by disabling all public exposure at the bucket boundary. The aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource enables block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, and restrict_public_buckets, ensuring the bucket and its objects can only be accessed by authorized IAM principals.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.

implemented-requirements.description: Content of audit records is captured by configuring S3 server access logging via aws_s3_bucket_logging. Every interaction (requester, bucket name, request time, action, response status) is logged and automatically routed to an isolated, encrypted log bucket.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.

implemented-requirements.description: Configuration settings enforce an approved security baseline. Bucket versioning is enabled via aws_s3_bucket_versioning to preserve object state and guard against unintended overwrites or deletions. Additionally, mandatory compliance tags (Project, Environment, ManagedBy, ComplianceScope) are systematically applied across resources via provider default_tags.
